summary: Typosquat with install-time beacon to attacker-controlled host
details: Package name `web-pixels-manager` typosquats Shopify's scoped `@shopify/web-pixels-manager`; the stated description (`get the IP location and metadata`) is unrelated to that name and the README is a one-line stub. `package.json` declares `preinstall: node index.js`, and `index.js` executes top-level code on `npm install` that performs an HTTPS GET to `https://realwbx.com/ip.php` with a hardcoded `Authorization` bearer token (via `getPublicIPLocation('8.8.8.8')`). The destination is not a Shopify or publisher-matching host. The install-time outbound call allows the operator of realwbx.com to enumerate hosts that installed the package, timestamp them, and correlate them to the hardcoded token, providing a victim check-in channel under a typosquatted name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
